metaTitle: Pricing: a free daily puzzle, Premium for the full suite
metaDescription: One module is free every day and never needs an account. Compare Free and Premium: the rest of today's suite, the puzzle archive, stats across every module and streak freezes.

hero.title: One puzzle free every day. Premium goes deeper.
hero.lead: Today's free module needs no account and no card. Premium opens the rest of today's suite, the puzzle archive, stats across every module and streak freezes — cancel any time.
hero.rotationBody: {rotating} modules take turns as the free daily puzzle, and all {total} modules run every day.
hero.rotationNote: New puzzles land at midnight, Hong Kong time.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: Free is a tier, not a trial. Premium is one plan, billed monthly or yearly.
plans.priceAtCheckoutNote: The price comes from our payment provider and is confirmed in your currency at checkout. We do not print a figure the billing system has not returned.
plans.trialNote: Cancel before the trial ends and you pay nothing.
plans.freeSubtitle: One module every day, no account
plans.freeFeatureAccount: No account and no card to play it
plans.freeFeatureStreak: Sign in to keep your streak and your stats
plans.premiumFeatureSuite: The rest of today's suite — every one of the {count} modules
plans.premiumFeatureArchive: The archive: play the past days you missed
plans.premiumFeatureStats: Stats across every module, not only the free one
plans.premiumFeatureFreeze: Streak freezes, so one missed day does not end a streak
plans.annualNote: Same plan as monthly, billed once a year.

billing.title: Billing, plainly
billing.subtitle: Four things worth knowing before you pay.
billing.secureTitle: Checkout runs on our payment provider
billing.secureBody: Card details go to the provider and never reach Puzzled. The amount you confirm there is the amount you pay.
billing.entitlementBody: Premium is an entitlement the server checks, so the full suite follows your subscription rather than anything a browser can set.
billing.cancelTitle: Cancel any time in the console
billing.cancelBody: Subscription settings hold the Manage Subscription control. Cancelling keeps your access until the end of the period you already paid for.
billing.refundBody: A person handles refunds: write to {email} within 7 days of the charge, as the terms describe.

compare.title: Free and Premium, side by side
compare.subtitle: What actually changes when you upgrade.

faq.title: Billing questions
faq.subtitle: Straight answers about paying, cancelling, trials and refunds.

cancel.question: How do I cancel Premium?
cancel.answer: Open Settings → Subscription and use Manage Subscription. You can cancel any time, and your access continues until the end of the period you already paid for.

trial.question: How does the {days}-day trial work?
trial.answer: Premium starts with {days} days free. Cancel before they end and nothing is charged; if you keep it, billing continues at the price shown at checkout.

price.question: Where do the prices come from?
price.answer: From our payment provider. Checkout shows the amount in your currency before you confirm, and that is the amount charged.

refund.question: Can I get a refund?
refund.answer: Refunds are handled by support: write to {email} within 7 days of the charge. The terms set out the policy in full.

access.question: When does Premium start?
access.answer: Premium is an entitlement our server checks, so the full suite opens as soon as the subscription is confirmed — on any device you sign in to.

switch.question: Can I move between monthly and yearly billing?
switch.answer: Yes. Both are the same Premium plan; the difference is how often you are billed.
